name.value: Southlands Grange Centre For Farming And Food

description.value: Southlands Grange is a community-based farm and market district on the Tsawwassen peninsula anchored by a working community farm, a flower farm, and the Southlands Tsawwassen Farmers Market featuring fresh local produce, baked goods, and handmade goods from local growers. The campus surrounds an open-air Market Square beside an orchard, with a restored historic Red Barn, commissary kitchen, and nearby cafés and local shops. A touring cyclist arriving here encounters authentic Metro Vancouver working farmland alongside a lively, food-focused community hub.
